# geolint

> ESLint for AI search. Audits websites for AI-search readiness — AI crawler
> access across 51 bot tokens, llms.txt, structured data and citability —
> with 52 rules, a 0–100 score, SARIF output, an MCP server and a GitHub
> Action. Run `npx @iliasabk/geolint check yoursite.com`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/iliasabk/geolint#readme): quickstart, features and CLI overview
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/iliasabk/geolint/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): every command, flag and exit code
- [Rule catalogue](https://github.com/iliasabk/geolint/blob/main/docs/rules.md): all 52 rules with severity and fixes
- [MCP server](https://github.com/iliasabk/geolint/blob/main/docs/mcp.md): audit sites from Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf
- [GitHub Action](https://github.com/iliasabk/geolint/blob/main/docs/github-action.md): SARIF upload, PR comments, score gates
- [Architecture](https://github.com/iliasabk/geolint/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): scan pipeline and engine internals
- [Writing rules](https://github.com/iliasabk/geolint/blob/main/docs/writing-rules.md): rule-authoring guide for contributors

## Live

- [Showcase](https://iliasabk.github.io/geolint/): real geolint reports for ten well-known sites
- [Metrics](https://github.com/iliasabk/geolint/tree/main/metrics): nightly dogfood scans committed by CI
